_about: Public-domain Franz Hettinger (1819-1890, Würzburg apologist) in English for the Word Hoard: Natural Religion (1890) and Revealed Religion (1895) from his Apologie des Christenthums, and Dante's Divina Commedia (1887), all edited by H. S. Bowden; Timothy, or Letters to a Young Theologian, tr. Victor Stepka (1902); and The Supremacy of the Apostolic See, tr. Archbishop George Porter; from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 29 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

hettinger-natural-religion: Natural Religion, from the Apologie des Christenthums, ed. Henry Sebastian Bowden (London: Burns and Oates, 1890)
